activity.notes: Collins was a leading revolutionary and intelligence organizer during the War of Independence within the Irish Republic proclaimed and ratified by the First Dáil in 1919. This Activity replaces the former generic-Ireland political-community binding; the modern Ireland state identity is not back-projected over the revolutionary republic.

sources.title: Declaration of Independence — First Dáil, 21 January 1919
sources.citation_text: The First Dáil formally ratified the establishment of the Irish Republic on 21 January 1919 and claimed sole legislative authority for the Irish Parliament.
